title: Rav Ada bar Acha
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Zevachim 22a, from which Hyman infers that he lived in Abaye’s time. In Keritot 14a he said, “Five sin-offerings,” etc. But where he is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:2, folio 7b, “Rav Hamnuna and Rav Ada bar Acha in the name of Rav,” and likewise in 9:3, “Rabbi Ba bar Hamnuna, Rav Ada bar Acha in the name of Rav,” Hyman identifies him as Rav Ada bar Ahavah, who is called Achavah or Acha in the Jerusalem Talmud.

notes.text: The proposed identification with Rav Ada bar Ahavah and the inference about Abaye’s time remain Hyman’s conclusions; the named Zevachim occurrence alone does not prove either.
